job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Development

Design and implement RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluation).
Build enterprise conversational AI systems with guardrails, audit logging, and telemetry.
Support multi-model environments (Azure OpenAI, Llama, Claude, multimodal models).

Agentic AI & Integration

Develop agent-based systems using Azure AI Agent Service and frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen).
Implement MCP-based integrations with secure tool-calling, RBAC, and governance.
Enable agent lifecycle management (registration, monitoring, governance).

Data & Pipeline Engineering

Build ingestion pipelines with PII redaction, metadata enrichment, and lineage tracking.
Manage vectorization pipelines with quality and drift monitoring.
Use ADF, Databricks, and AWS EMR for large-scale data processing.

Model Ops & Engineering Excellence

Evaluate and fine-tune models across quality, safety, latency, and cost dimensions.
Implement CI/CD pipelines with testing and security integration.
Optimize performance (latency, cost, indexing, caching).

Security & Compliance

Apply secure coding, RBAC, least privilege, and threat modeling.
Ensure adherence to Responsible AI and enterprise security standards.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Skills

Strong expertise in:
RAG, embeddings, vector databases, transformer-based models
Agentic AI systems and orchestration frameworks
Programming:
Python and React (mandatory)
TypeScript, C# (preferred for UI integrations/enterprise integrations)

Frameworks & Tools

LangChain, LangGraph (must-have)
FastAPI for API development
Azure DevOps / CI-CD pipelines
Semantic Kernel / AutoGen / CrewAI / similar

Cloud Platforms

Azure AI stack (Azure App service, OpenAI, AI Search, Databricks, ADF, AKS, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Azure APIM, Key-vault, Blob Storage, Microsoft Entra ID)
AWS AI stack (SageMaker, Bedrock, EMR, Lambda)

Experience

6+ years software engineering (enterprise systems)
2+ years GenAI/LLM implementation (RAG, agents, evaluation)

Certification Requirements


Mandatory (Suggested):
Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900)
Responsible AI certifications
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
TensorFlow Developer
Kubernetes CKA/CKAD
SAFe Agile Software Engineering (ASE)

Preferred:
Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to design, build, and scale secure, enterprise-grade AI solutions, with a strong focus on RAG pipelines, agentic AI, and cloud-native AI platforms (Azure & AWS).

The role requires deep software engineering discipline, hands-on GenAI implementation, and strong alignment with security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
